SKINFOOD Carrot PDRN Pad 210g (100 Pads)

 

Description

SKINFOOD Carrot PDRN Pad is a moisture boosting toner pad formulated with Carrot Extract and highly purified Carrot PDRN to deliver deep hydration while helping improve skin elasticity. The essence rich formula adheres comfortably to the skin, providing intensive moisture care that leaves the complexion plump, smooth, and refreshed.

Made with a thin and soft tension pad sheet, it closely fits the skin to maximize moisture delivery without irritation. This dual functional skincare pad helps brighten the complexion and improve the appearance of fine lines while supporting a healthy, hydrated skin barrier. Perfect for dry, dull, and dehydrated skin in need of long lasting moisture and radiance.

How to use

After cleansing, apply to both cheeks or areas in need of moisture and firmness care. Gently wipe over the entire face except the eye area and pat in any remaining essence until absorbed.

Ingredients

Water, Glycerin, Niacinamide, 1,2-Hexanediol, Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Root Extract (801 ppm), Candida Bombicola/Glucose/Methyl Rapeseedate Ferment, Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Seed Oil (11,390 ppb), Vincetoxicum Atratum Extract, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Peel Oil, Lavandula Hybrida Oil, Salvia Officinalis (Sage) Oil, Artemisia Vulgaris Oil, Althaea Rosea Flower Extract, Ocimum Basilicum (Basil) Oil, Sodium Hyaluronate, Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Extract (10 ppb), Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Seed Extract (10 ppb), Glycereth-26, Butylene Glycol, Hydroxyacetophenone, Cetyl Ethylhexanoate, Diethoxyethyl Succinate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Allantoin, Squalane, Trehalose, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Tromethamine, Propanediol, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Adenosine, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Hydroxyethyl Urea, Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose, Polyglyceryl-10 Isostearate, Polyglyceryl-10 Oleate, Pentylene Glycol, Tocopherol, Beta-Carotene, Sodium DNA (10 ppb)*, Caffeine, Disodium EDTA
